changeSet.author: nexus-o8dil.18
changeSet.comment: nexus.live_chunks: rebuilt against the unified nexus.chunks, ONE SELECT (no UNION ALL needed — each chunk is now one row, not one row per dim shard). DERIVED dim column via CASE keyed on WHICH embedding_<dim> column IS NOT NULL (never the vector's own width, which is unrecoverable at the SQL level anyway once cast to bare `vector`). embedding is COALESCE(embedding_384, embedding_768, embedding_1024)::vector — the three typed columns share one base pgvector type differing only by typmod, exactly mirroring how the OLD three-way UNION ALL already resolved to the untyped `vector` column type.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.live_chunks WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash, c.chunk_text, COALESCE(c.embedding_384, c.embedding_768, c.embedding_1024)::vector AS embedding, c.chunk_tsv, c.metadata, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE (NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash )) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash AND d.deleted_at IS NULL );
GRANT SELECT ON nexus.live_chunks TO PUBLIC;

changeSet.author: nexus-o8dil.18
changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_vector_stats: UNCHANGED body (still SELECTs FROM nexus.live_chunks, grouped by dim) — re-created only because CASCADE dropped it alongside live_chunks. GRANT SELECT TO PUBLIC preserved.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT lc.tenant_id, lc.collection, lc.dim, count(*) AS chunk_count, max(lc.created_at) AS last_write FROM nexus.live_chunks lc GROUP BY lc.tenant_id, lc.collection, lc.dim;
GRANT SELECT ON nexus.collection_vector_stats TO PUBLIC;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.remap_membership( p_source_collection text, p_target_collection text ) RETURNS TABLE(mapped_total bigint, present_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ WITH fact AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN r.new_chash ~ '^[0-9a-f]+$' AND length(r.new_chash) % 2 = 0 THEN decode(r.new_chash, 'hex') ELSE convert_to(r.new_chash, 'UTF8') END AS key_bytes FROM nexus.chash_remap r WHERE r.source_collection = p_source_collection AND r.target_collection = p_target_collection ), resolved AS ( SELECT COALESCE(a.new_chash, f.key_bytes) AS chash FROM fact f LEFT JOIN nexus.chash_alias a ON a.old_bytes = f.key_bytes ) SELECT count(*)::bigint AS mapped_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.collection = p_target_collection AND c.chash = resolved.chash) )::bigint AS present_count FROM resolved $fn$;

changeSet.comment: manifest_verify / manifest_verify_all (DECISION 1: re-created, not early-deleted): the three-way OR across EXISTS(chunks_384/768/1024) collapses to one EXISTS(nexus.chunks). Signatures, tombstone/NULL-collection/reader-contract semantics unchanged (catalog-020-3/4).
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify(p_doc_id text) RETURNS TABLE( referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ WITH manifest AS ( SELECT c.chash, c.collection FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks c JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = c.doc_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND c.doc_id = p_doc_id AND c.collection IS NOT NULL ), checked AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) AS is_present FROM manifest m ) SELECT count(*)::bigint AS referenced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present)::bigint AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_present)::bigint AS missing FROM checked $$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify_all() RETURNS TABLE( collection text, referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ WITH manifest AS ( SELECT c.chash, c.collection FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks c JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = c.doc_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND c.collection IS NOT NULL ), checked AS ( SELECT m.collection, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) AS is_present FROM manifest m ) SELECT collection, count(*)::bigint AS referenced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present)::bigint AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_present)::bigint AS missing FROM checked GROUP BY collection $$;

changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.assign_from_chashes_384( p_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_cross_collection boolean ) RETURNS TABLE( chash text, topic_id bigint, similarity double precision ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ #variable_conflict use_column BEGIN IF p_cross_collection THEN INSERT INTO nexus.catalog_collections (tenant_id, name) VALUES (current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), p_collection) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, name) DO NOTHING;
RETURN QUERY WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.chash) encode(c.chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, ct.topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384))::double precision AS m_sim FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct ON ct.collection <> p_collection AND ct.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ORDER BY c.chash, (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384) ASC, ct.collection ASC, ct.topic_id ASC ), persisted AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.topic_assignments AS ta (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id, assigned_by, similarity, assigned_at, source_collection) SELECT current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, 'projection', n.m_sim, now(), p_collection FROM nearest n ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id) DO UPDATE SET similarity = GREATEST(COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0), EXCLUDED.similarity), assigned_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.similarity > COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0) THEN EXCLUDED.assigned_at ELSE ta.assigned_at END, source_collection = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.similarity > COALESCE(ta.similarity, -1.0) THEN EXCLUDED.source_collection ELSE ta.source_collection END, assigned_by = 'projection' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, n.m_sim FROM nearest n; ELSE RETURN QUERY WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.chash) encode(c.chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, ct.topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384))::double precision AS m_sim FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct ON ct.collection = p_collection AND ct.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ORDER BY c.chash, (c.embedding_384 <=> ct.embedding_384) ASC, ct.topic_id ASC ), persisted AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.topic_assignments (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id, assigned_by) SELECT current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, 'centroid' FROM nearest n ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, NULL::double precision FROM nearest n; END IF; END; $fn$;

ELSE RETURN QUERY WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.chash) encode(c.chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, ct.topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - (c.embedding_1024 <=> ct.embedding_1024))::double precision AS m_sim FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct ON ct.collection = p_collection AND ct.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ORDER BY c.chash, (c.embedding_1024 <=> ct.embedding_1024) ASC, ct.topic_id ASC ), persisted AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.topic_assignments (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id, assigned_by) SELECT current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, 'centroid' FROM nearest n ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, doc_id, topic_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, NULL::double precision FROM nearest n; END IF; END; $fn$;
